text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon.
While walking through the academy—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —And so, ta-da~! I tried making gratin today.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that looks delicious...!
Bubble changes up her side dishes every single time, it's truly amazing.
I need to follow her example.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, nah~ Waltz's fried chicken is a classic taste we all know and love!
It's great just the way it is~."

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
I'll serve the salad.
...Lapis. If you're just going to stand there watching,
pass me the paper towels.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I spotted Bubble Gum Fellow sitting on a picnic mat with her friends, laying out food.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Oh—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
There's Trainer.
Hey—!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Let me introduce them to everyone once again.
This is my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: She's someone with a deeply passionate dream.

text_block_list.name: Bubble's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, thank you for looking after Bubble."
"'Sup~!"
"Hello."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Over here are my childhood and best friends.
They've all been my companions since our club days.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly!
I'll introduce them in order.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
She is Waltz of Shadow!
She's calm and has great situational awareness.
Among us, she's sort of like the group's mediator.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is a little embarrassing.
—I am Waltz of Shadow.
Pleased to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And this is Holy Cure!
She's studious and a very quick thinker.
Her judgment is steady and calm. ...Kind of like a strategist, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, "-ish"?
—It's Holy Cure. Pleased to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And last is Sol Lapis.
Very bright and energetic. That's all!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's all?! Why was mine so half-assed!
You could say more, right?!
Like "That cute girl who looks great in pink♪" or something!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well, that's just how she is—
our mood maker!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“—Today is 'Share-a-Lunch Day.'
We occasionally do this where everyone brings side dishes and we all eat together.”

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
It's also meant to be a catch-up session.
Our dorm rooms are all separate, so I thought
we needed an opportunity like this.
choice_data_list: Is it really okay for someone like me to be here?
Is it really okay for someone like me to be here?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I was planning on
introducing you to everyone eventually anyway.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Would you like some tea, Trainer?
I do have juice prepared as well, though—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, Trainer, have you tried
Bubble-chan's cooking before~?
Bubble-chan is super good at cooking, you know~!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha! Everyone settled in so fast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I had a fun meal around the table
together with Bubble Gum Fellow and the other Heavenly Kings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When Bubble Gum Fellow was with his close friends, it felt to me like he laughed out loud far more often than usual...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing lunch, I ended up supervising a joint training session with all four Heavenly Kings—

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: —I've summarized a few common challenges everyone is facing. Today, I'd like to propose training sessions to address them.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Bubble's Trainer is here too, so let's work on this while having them check the details.
Trainer-san, please take a look at this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The documents Holy Cure handed over contained a training plan tailored to the current situation, organized in an exceptionally clear and readable way...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! Training together really gets you hyped up after all~! I'm gonna give it my all today~!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too carried away, Lapis.
Let's keep in step together.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: “—First, we'll all do an easy warmup lap together. I'll set the pace as usual!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Bubble Gum Fellow's lead,
the rest of the Big Four start running too.
Their sheer momentum turns into wind that brushes my cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Here we go, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Following right behind Bubble Gum Fellow, who seized the lead, Waltz of Shadow and the others also began running sharper and stronger."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I'm reminded that every single one of the
Four Heavenly Kings possesses extraordinary talent.
And above all else—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha! Not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow looked cheerful at the head of the pack.
Her presence truly seemed worthy of being called the "Point Man" of the Heavenly Kings...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, I'm totally exhausted~!
I can't move anymore~. Cure-chan, carry me~

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Walk on your own.
I'm leaving you behind.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Thank you very much
for watching over our training today.
choice_data_list: Same here. That was a great workout.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"If the opportunity arises,
I'd love to do this again."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, everyone. Our respective
debut races are finally drawing near."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Once I debut, it'll become a real battlefield. I expect harsh, grinding days ahead as everyone fiercely competes for the top—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: "Still, if we keep looking forward, give it our all, and deliver our best runs, the results will surely follow...!"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
We might get even more famous, don'tcha think~?
The strongest pink Solapis-chan is totally on fire~!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
As the Four Heavenly Kings, we shall carve our names
into racing history and become a new foundation.
...My heart is leaping with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Together, all of us here will carve out the future.
Without leaving a single one behind, as the Four Heavenly Kings!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm holding ittt!!
Fight!!!

text_block_list.name: Waltzes
text_block_list.text: “““OOOOHHHH!!!”””

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
thank you so much for today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to have an even
better training session with everyone than usual.
choice_data_list: ...You two really have a strong bond, don't you?
...You two really share a powerful bond, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
We've been working hard together ever since we were little,
so I feel a really strong bond with her—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I called us "childhood best friends" today,
but we're basically family at this point.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And those bonds... always give me strength.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: To let our dreams swell, that is.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Still, there's something I want you to know—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Because I believe that the bond I share with you, Trainer, is also essential for nurturing my dreams.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's why—
let's keep joining our strengths together even more from now on.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Strong enough to rival
our bond with Waltz and the others!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because I felt the strong bond between Bubble Gum Fellow
and her best friends—the warmth of our bumped fists
resonates deep within my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer,
I will forge a bond second to none.
That was the vow I made in my heart.
